svg.text: K9b SCHLICHT — the simplest combined machine
One 4-axis hand (gripper = roll axis), a turning heated hub, a 2-zone domino, a high oven, one well for all washing.
6 motion actuators · 2 dynamic seals (Z band, Y band)
est. cost: appliances ≈ 3.3–3.8 k€ + machine part ≈ 6.8 k€ (5–9 k€)
FRONT VIEW (fronts and cell door removed)
transport gallery z 2000–2200, ceiling ports into each module
X box: belt axis, labyrinth slot

g.text: lamp green: diner pulls the drawer

svg.text: TOP VIEW (cell at deck level z 870)
3 Diced in the press cup on the hub
4 Kneaded / stirred on the heated hub
6 Hook opens the oven door, tray in
8 Dish carrier flipped over the chute
9 Ware and dishes into the wash well
seals (Z and Y bands, not visible here)
Not shown: fetching tools and ware from the tool cabinet and the well, lids, the plate cradle, the
rinse-cup spout and the camera checks; times compressed. Every item carries the same bayonet stub.
THE HAND (schematic side view, rear wall left)
X: belt module in the dry X box; labyrinth slot, no seal; 1640 mm
Z: ball screw on the hanging mast; sealing band 1; 900 mm, 400 N
Y: belt in the closed arm tube on a load cell (±5 g); sealing band 2
roll: canned magnet coupling on a 300 mm drop link; 10 Nm, 150 rpm
gripper = roll sleeve: every item has a stub, roll 60° locks it
T, S under the deck turn the hub through a closed pocket (no seal)

g.text: 1/9 Box tipped and weighed: the hand grips the stub of an opened box on the shelf, tips it over the rinse cup and weighs 800 g out by loss in weight
2/9 Peeled on the spit: the roll turns the potato at 60 rpm, Y draws it past the blade post on the chute rim; the 1 mm depth shoe sets the cut, peel falls to the bin
3/9 Diced in the press cup on the hub: T turns the screw base, the piston pushes the potatoes up through the 10 mm dicer grid; the spatula sweeps the cubes out
4/9 Kneaded and stirred on the hub: T turns the bowl under the hung kneading roller (reaction on the anchor post); for sauces the ring coil heats the pot
5/9 Frying on the domino: the disher drops 8 portions into the pan on the rear zone, the turner presses them flat; turned every 3 min, probe to 72 °C core
6/9 Oven: the hook rod pulls the drop-down door open (it becomes a shelf over the hub); the tray slides in along +X, the rod closes the door; 220 °C
7/9 Plating: warm plates on the heated hatch tray, mash and potatoes by ladle, patties by turner; the green lamp lights, the diner pulls the drawer 300 mm out
8/9 Dish return: plates slotted into the carrier in the drawer; the hand rolls it 180° over the chute, scraps fall into the bio bin, the bars hold the plates
9/9 Washing: lid (bench) swung up, carrier, pots and pans hung on edge in the combs; one wash for ware and dishes, final rinse ≥ 82 °C for 60 s
